about: What agent-repl needs on a machine to run (profile run) and to be built and tested (profile dev). bin/requirements.sh reads this file and every file it includes; see the Requirements section of AGENTS.md.

requirements.why: installs every other macOS requirement below

install.manual: Install Homebrew from https://brew.sh, then re-run bin/requirements.sh install.

requirements.why: bin/requirements.sh reads these manifests with it; macOS 15 and later ship it at /usr/bin/jq
every workspace is a git worktree

install.manual: Install the Xcode Command Line Tools with `xcode-select --install`.

requirements.why: agent-repl is a Doom Emacs module, and its panel is an xwidget-webkit webview
agent-repl loads as a module of this Doom configuration (`doom sync`, `doom env`)

install.manual: Install Doom Emacs (https://github.com/doomemacs/doomemacs#install) with this repository as ~/.config/doom, and put ~/.config/emacs/bin on PATH.

requirements.why: bin/requirements.sh downloads the download-kind entries (spell-dictionary) with it; macOS ships it

install.manual: Install curl with your distribution's package manager.

requirements.why: bin/requirements.sh unpacks the download-kind entries (spell-dictionary) with it; macOS ships it

install.manual: Install unzip with your distribution's package manager.

requirements.why: bin/requirements.sh checks every download-kind file against its pinned sha256 with it; macOS ships it

install.manual: Install perl's shasum with your distribution's package manager.

requirements.why: every workspace session runs the Claude Code CLI, and the daemon's headless calls run it too

install.manual: Install Claude Code (https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code) and sign in once with `claude`.

requirements.why: the daemon's desktop banners on macOS (daemon/internal/desktopnotify); version 3 posts through UserNotifications, which macOS 26 requires

the daemon's desktop banners on Linux (daemon/internal/desktopnotify)

requirements.why: the external-boundary lint gate every commit passes
keeps master to the merge queue, and journals the refs a test run's own git moves for safe-test-run.sh's drift check
refuses a master push without its version label's release-<version> tag (bin/push-release.sh makes one)
lints every bin/ and scripts/ shell script in the shell suites
bin/report-logging-density.sh searches the sources with it
bin/daemon-contract-current.sh and the log-discovery and shim-doctor scripts run on it

install.manual: Install the Xcode Command Line Tools with `xcode-select --install`.
